questions.question: Identify the correct form of the verb in brackets to complete the sentence: 'If only I [think] that way.'
options: think
had thought
would think
should think

questions.question: Which sentence correctly uses the subjunctive mood to express a hypothetical situation?
options: If I were you, I would accept the job.
If I was you, I would accept the job.
If I had been you, I would accept the job.
If I were being you, I would accept the job.
questions.answer: If I were you, I would accept the job.

questions.question: Select the option that correctly completes the sentence with ellipsis: 'She is a talented singer, ________ she is not well-known.'
options: but
although
however
whereas

questions.question: Which of the following sentences correctly uses a cleft sentence to emphasize the location?
options: It was in London that the meeting took place.
It was London where the meeting took place.
London it was where the meeting took place.
The meeting took place in London, which was.
questions.answer: It was in London that the meeting took place.

questions.question: Choose the correct form to complete the sentence: 'Had she known the truth, ________.'
options: she might not have reacted so strongly.
she might not react so strongly.
she might not reacted so strongly.
she might not react so stronglyed.
questions.answer: she might not have reacted so strongly.
